item.title: The Surprising Science of Body Temperature Regulation
item.description: Explore the fascinating world of body temperature regulation with this episode of Body Oddities. Discover how your body stays cool, warm, and why you sweat or shiver in the wild. From the science of sweating to the role of the hypothalamus, learn how your body maintains a delicate balance to keep you alive in extreme conditions.
